knowledgeAnswers.rationale: SP 02 (Version 3, 26 September 2023), mesh section: a 25 kg weight is applied at any point on the top of a non-boundary mesh panel.
VBA note (2018), doors section: child-resistant doorsets cannot serve as barrier parts around outdoor water.

SP 02 (Version 3, 26 September 2023), indoor pool section: a side-hung door used as part of an indoor pool barrier must swing away from the pool, be self-closing and self-latching, and have a non-climbable zone on its outside.

practicalCriteria: On a supplied gate, shows it shuts and latches from rest and after the 25 kg load, and records the result.
Identifies from a supplied door arrangement whether it opens straight onto an outdoor pool, and records the correction required.
Checks a supplied side-hung indoor pool door for swing direction, self-closing, self-latching and the non-climbable zone on its outside, and records the result.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Gate test record for the assessed gate
Assessor observation of the 25 kg test
stopWorkCriteria: Gate does not latch itself: do not adjust it as a repair; report and keep the pool closed to small children.
Door opening straight onto an outdoor pool zone: report and do not accept the barrier.
Indoor pool side-hung door does not swing away, self-close or self-latch: report and do not accept the barrier.
